finance_puzzle.question: A company has Revenue = ₹500 Cr, EBITDA margin = 20%, Debt = ₹300 Cr, Interest rate = 9%. What happens to profit (before tax) if revenue falls 10%?
finance_puzzle.answer:
Old EBITDA = ₹100 Cr → Profit before interest cost of ₹27 Cr = ₹73 Cr.
New revenue = ₹450 Cr → New EBITDA = ₹90 Cr → New profit before tax = ₹63 Cr.
That's a change of ₹-10 Cr — notice how a 10% revenue fall swings profit by a much bigger percentage. That's operating leverage.
